gloss: to hold, to have, to carry

definitions.explanation: To have something in one's hands or to carry something. Physical possession or holding.
To own or possess something. {車|くるま}を{持|も}っている (to have a car).
For something to remain in good condition or to endure. この{電池|でんち}は{長|なが}く{持|も}つ (this battery lasts long).

examples.japanese: {傘|かさ}を{持|も}っていますか。
{荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}ちましょうか。
この{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}はあと{何日|なんにち}{持|も}ちますか。
examples.english: How many more days will this milk last?

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xを{持|も}つ (hold/have X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {持|も}っている = 'has/possesses' (ownership state, very common).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{傘|かさ}を{持|も}っている (have an umbrella)
・{荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}つ (carry luggage)
・{車|くるま}を{持|も}っている (own a car)
・{長|なが}く{持|も}つ (last long)

Godan verb: te-form {持|も}って. Compare: ある (existence), {持|も}つ (ownership/carrying). Sense 3 (last/endure) is intransitive usage.
